Classification: High Clan

The @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.GaCuLGcjZZjf2EO6]{Toreador}, called the Artisans, resist the emotional distancing the Embrace usually brings by maintaining close ties to mortals and mortal art. Clan legend holds that their founder Arikel was cursed by Caine himself to be forever distracted by beauty, after a sculpture she made displeased him; through appreciation of beauty, however, @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.GaCuLGcjZZjf2EO6]{Toreador} retain some understanding of the human condition. The clan is deeply entwined with the Church (as patrons, clergy-turned-vampires, or seekers of redemption) and with noble courts, having created the Courts of Love, now a major power in the War of Princes.

Disciplines: Auspex, Celerity, Presence

Advantage: Every Toreador begins with Academics, Crafts, Performance or Subterfuge — one Trait each of any two, or two Traits of one.

Disadvantage: When presented with a work of great art, a Toreador becomes absorbed in it, lost in a fugue state. They can only break free willingly by expending a Mental Trait, though injury or another distraction can also break the enthrallment.

Organization: No central hierarchy; Toreador cluster around patronage networks, artistic circles, and the Courts of Love.

Suggested Viae: Humanity, Kings.
